_readme: Delivery routes. Copied to config/mwh/routes.json on first boot; edit that copy.
spawn      - where the runner is teleported when the convoy is authorised.
drop       - where the cargo has to reach. Delivery radius is in the server config.
riskTier   - 1..3, drawn as filled pips in the dispatch screen.
multiplier - payout multiplier for choosing this route.
The three below are the prototype's hardcoded pairs, preserved exactly. Add a fourth by
appending an object here - nothing in the code assumes there are only three.
